captions.stack_rule: only short punchy lines (<=3 words) that land a beat: rhetorical questions, answers, 'nobody else', 'right now'. Longer lines fall back to over_aroll.

broll.cut_on: phrase boundaries; one shot per phrase, or one shot across two short phrases that share an idea
broll.aroll_lines: hook first line, 'I' claims and opinions, rhetorical questions to camera, the direct ask/CTA, and the last line
match_order: planned shot from the shot list
literal: the person/place/object/action named in the line
embodied: a movement or image that acts the line out (walking away = leaving, looking back = turn back, sunset = payoff)
never: the same clip twice in one video
clips of other people talking to camera
client footage unless the line is about client work
